mentions.name: wiktionary_stardict
mentions.description: This tool converts Wiktionary HTML snapshots into StarDict dictionary files for use with the KOReader e-reader application.
mentions.problem: No existing tool converted Wiktionary HTML snapshots into StarDict dictionaries for KOReader, so the author built one.
